items.source: The column name. The attribute supports Value Expressions to dynamically obtain the column name on a per-operation basis. Expressions returning a String are sanitized prior usage. Expressions can also return a SqlIdentifier directly that is used as-is without further sanitization.
items.translation: 列名。该属性支持值表达式，以便按操作动态获取列名。返回 String 的表达式在 sanitized 之前使用。表达式也可以直接返回一个 SqlIdentifier，该标识符将原样使用，无需进一步清理。

items.source: The annotation to configure the mapping from an attribute to a database column.
items.translation: 用于配置从属性到数据库列映射的注解。

items.source: Kazuki Shimizu, Florian Lüdiger, Bastian Wilhelm, Mark Paluch
